brief.en: Zombies that eat it are defeated and release gas
brief.zh: 僵尸吃下后死亡并释放眩晕气体

description.en: Chili Beans deliver a crippling bout of gastrointestinal distress.
description.zh: 巴豆会对吞食他的敌人施加致命的毒素攻击，并使其释放眩晕气体。

chat.en: He's not blushing, he's trying to hold it in.
chat.zh: 他不是脸红了，而是一直在憋着什么。

text.en: eating zombie is destroyed and releases stunning gas
text.zh: 吃掉他的僵尸直接死亡，并且释放眩晕气体
